CREATE TABLE ingest_batches (
	batch_id BIGINT NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT, 
	source VARCHAR(32) COLLATE utf8mb4_bin NOT NULL, 
	mode VARCHAR(16) COLLATE utf8mb4_bin NOT NULL, 
	status VARCHAR(16) COLLATE utf8mb4_bin NOT NULL, 
	started_at DATETIME(6) NOT NULL, 
	finished_at DATETIME(6), 
	source_snapshot_ref VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, 
	counts_json JSON NOT NULL, 
	error_summary VARCHAR(512), 
	PRIMARY KEY (batch_id), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_ingest_batches_0 CHECK (mode IN ('dry-run','write')),

movies.ddl:
CREATE TABLE movies (
	movie_id BIGINT NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT, 
	title VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, 
	original_title VARCHAR(255), 
	release_date DATE, 
	release_year SMALLINT, 
	runtime_minutes SMALLINT, 
	original_language VARCHAR(16) COLLATE utf8mb4_bin, 
	overview TEXT, 
	catalog_status VARCHAR(16) COLLATE utf8mb4_bin NOT NULL DEFAULT 'draft', 
	is_adult BOOL, 
	created_at DATETIME(6) NOT NULL, 
	updated_at DATETIME(6) NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (movie_id), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_movies_0 CHECK (catalog_status IN ('draft','active','hidden')), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_movies_1 CHECK (release_year IS NULL OR release_year BETWEEN 1800 AND 2199), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_movies_2 CHECK (runtime_minutes IS NULL OR (runtime_minutes>0 AND runtime_minutes<=1500))
)CHARSET=utf8mb4 ENGINE=InnoDB
indexes: CREATE INDEX ix_movies_0 ON movies (catalog_status, release_year, movie_id)

data_quality_issues.ddl:
CREATE TABLE data_quality_issues (
	id BIGINT NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT, 
	batch_id BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	source VARCHAR(32) COLLATE utf8mb4_bin NOT NULL, 
	source_record_id VARCHAR(128) COLLATE utf8mb4_bin NOT NULL, 
	issue_type VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	severity VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, 
	status VARCHAR(16) COLLATE utf8mb4_bin NOT NULL, 
	detail_json JSON NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME(6) NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_data_quality_issues_0 UNIQUE (batch_id, source, source_record_id, issue_type), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_data_quality_issues_0 CHECK (severity IN ('info','warning','error')), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_data_quality_issues_1 CHECK (status IN ('open','resolved','accepted')), 
	FOREIGN KEY(batch_id) REFERENCES ingest_batches (batch_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT ON UPDATE RESTRICT
)CHARSET=utf8mb4 ENGINE=InnoDB
indexes: CREATE INDEX ix_data_quality_issues_0 ON data_quality_issues (status, severity, id)

ingest_items.ddl:
CREATE TABLE ingest_items (
	id BIGINT NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT, 
	batch_id BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	source_record_id VARCHAR(128) COLLATE utf8mb4_bin NOT NULL, 
	status VARCHAR(16) COLLATE utf8mb4_bin NOT NULL, 
	movie_id BIGINT, 
	error_code VARCHAR(64), 
	payload_hash CHAR(64) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL, 
	attempt_count INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT '1', 
	updated_at DATETIME(6) NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_ingest_items_0 UNIQUE (batch_id, source_record_id), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_ingest_items_0 CHECK (status IN ('inserted','updated','skipped','review','error')), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_ingest_items_1 CHECK (attempt_count>=1), 
	FOREIGN KEY(batch_id) REFERENCES ingest_batches (batch_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT ON UPDATE RESTRICT, 
	FOREIGN KEY(movie_id) REFERENCES movies (movie_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT ON UPDATE RESTRICT
)CHARSET=utf8mb4 ENGINE=InnoDB

legacy_movie_map.ddl:
CREATE TABLE legacy_movie_map (
	id BIGINT NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT, 
	legacy_table VARCHAR(16) COLLATE utf8mb4_bin NOT NULL, 
	legacy_pk BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	legacy_douban_id VARCHAR(128) COLLATE utf8mb4_bin, 
	movie_id BIGINT, 
	match_status VARCHAR(16) COLLATE utf8mb4_bin NOT NULL, 
	match_method VARCHAR(32), 
	reviewed_at DATETIME(6), 
	reason_code VARCHAR(64) COLLATE utf8mb4_bin, 
	reason_note VARCHAR(255), 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_legacy_movie_map_0 UNIQUE (legacy_table, legacy_pk), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_legacy_movie_map_0 CHECK (legacy_table IN ('movies','movies2')), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_legacy_movie_map_1 CHECK (match_status IN ('matched','unmatched','review','blocked','skipped')), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_legacy_movie_map_2 CHECK (match_status<>'matched' OR movie_id IS NOT NULL), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_legacy_movie_map_3 CHECK (match_status NOT IN ('skipped','blocked') OR (reason_code IS NOT NULL AND CHAR_LENGTH(TRIM(reason_code))>0)), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_legacy_movie_map_4 CHECK (reason_code IS NULL OR reason_code IN ('excluded_tv','invalid_source_id','type_conflict','identity_conflict','requires_review')), 
	FOREIGN KEY(movie_id) REFERENCES movies (movie_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT ON UPDATE RESTRICT
)CHARSET=utf8mb4 ENGINE=InnoDB

CREATE TABLE match_reviews (

	source VARCHAR(32) COLLATE utf8mb4_bin NOT NULL, 
	source_record_id VARCHAR(128) COLLATE utf8mb4_bin NOT NULL, 
	candidate_movie_id BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	match_features_json JSON NOT NULL, 
	status VARCHAR(16) COLLATE utf8mb4_bin NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending', 
	review_reason VARCHAR(512), 
	reviewed_at DATETIME(6), 
	approved_source_record_id VARCHAR(128) COLLATE utf8mb4_bin GENERATED ALWAYS AS (CASE WHEN status='approved' THEN source_record_id ELSE NULL END) VIRTUAL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_match_reviews_0 UNIQUE (source, source_record_id, candidate_movie_id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_match_reviews_1 UNIQUE (source, approved_source_record_id), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_match_reviews_0 CHECK (status IN ('pending','approved','rejected')), 
	FOREIGN KEY(candidate_movie_id) REFERENCES movies (movie_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT ON UPDATE RESTRICT
)CHARSET=utf8mb4 ENGINE=InnoDB
indexes: CREATE INDEX ix_match_reviews_0 ON match_reviews (status, id)

movie_assets.ddl:
CREATE TABLE movie_assets (
	asset_id BIGINT NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT, 
	movie_id BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	asset_type VARCHAR(16) COLLATE utf8mb4_bin NOT NULL, 
	source VARCHAR(16) COLLATE utf8mb4_bin NOT NULL, 
	source_path VARCHAR(512) COLLATE utf8mb4_bin NOT NULL, 
	language VARCHAR(16) COLLATE utf8mb4_bin, 
	width INTEGER, 
	height INTEGER, 
	is_primary BOOL NOT NULL DEFAULT '0', 
	license_status VARCHAR(24) COLLATE utf8mb4_bin NOT NULL, 
	updated_at DATETIME(6) NOT NULL, 
	primary_slot VARCHAR(16) COLLATE utf8mb4_bin GENERATED ALWAYS AS (CASE WHEN is_primary THEN asset_type ELSE NULL END) VIRTUAL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (asset_id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_movie_assets_0 UNIQUE (movie_id, asset_type, source, source_path), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_movie_assets_1 UNIQUE (movie_id, primary_slot), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_movie_assets_0 CHECK (asset_type IN ('poster','backdrop')), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_movie_assets_1 CHECK (width IS NULL OR width>0), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_movie_assets_2 CHECK (height IS NULL OR height>0), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_movie_assets_3 CHECK (NOT is_primary OR license_status='allowed'), 
	FOREIGN KEY(movie_id) REFERENCES movies (movie_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT ON UPDATE RESTRICT
)CHARSET=utf8mb4 ENGINE=InnoDB
indexes: CREATE INDEX ix_movie_assets_0 ON movie_assets (movie_id, asset_type, is_primary)

movie_ratings_summary.ddl:
CREATE TABLE movie_ratings_summary (
	movie_id BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	source VARCHAR(16) COLLATE utf8mb4_bin NOT NULL, 
	score_value NUMERIC(5, 2), 
	score_scale SMALLINT NOT NULL, 
	vote_count BIGINT, 
	observed_at DATETIME(6) NOT NULL, 
	selected_source_record_pk BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (movie_id, source), 
	CONSTRAINT fk_rating_source_movie FOREIGN KEY(selected_source_record_pk, movie_id) REFERENCES movie_source_records (id, movie_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT ON UPDATE RESTRICT, 
	CONSTRAINT ck_movie_ratings_summary_0 CHECK (score_scale>0), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_movie_ratings_summary_1 CHECK (vote_count IS NULL OR vote_count>=0), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_movie_ratings_summary_2 CHECK (score_value IS NULL OR (score_value>=0 AND score_value<=score_scale)), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_movie_ratings_summary_3 CHECK (vote_count IS NULL OR vote_count<>0 OR score_value IS NULL), 
	FOREIGN KEY(movie_id) REFERENCES movies (movie_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT ON UPDATE RESTRICT
)CHARSET=utf8mb4 ENGINE=InnoDB
indexes: CREATE INDEX ix_movie_ratings_summary_0 ON movie_ratings_summary (selected_source_record_pk, movie_id)
